factProposals.value: The plan carries no requirements, so it has no measures, no SAFE guardrails, no named external systems and no traceability yet; the Outcomes, Guardrails, Systems, Knowledge base traceability and Data model domain views render empty states.
No story names its role in the 'As a <role>, I want' form, so no user roles could be extracted.
The plan has no scoped agent roster and every story's owner_agent is empty, so all 53 stories are Unassigned.
factProposals.evidence: .colaberry/plan.json (agents is empty; owner_agent is empty on all 53 stories)

factProposals.value: Every release window starts and ends on 2026-09-20 and demo day is 2026-09-27, both earlier than the build itself, so every unverified story shows as past due.

decisions.statement: The Command Center reads .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json at runtime and calls no admin endpoint and holds no token.
decisions.rationale: A static page in a public repo cannot keep a secret; the builder chose files only.

decisions.statement: The Knowledge base chat answers by matching the question against known topics, story ids and story titles in the loaded data, with no model and no network call.
decisions.rationale: No API key can live on a static page, and an answer must cite its tab or say it cannot answer.

decisions.statement: Project notes and decisions live in knowledge/notes.json at the repo root, not under docs/.
decisions.rationale: docs/ is rewritten by the platform on every sync.

limitations.statement: The chat recognises only known topics, story ids and story title words; any other question is answered with 'I can't answer that from the data on this page.'
Opened straight from the file system the page cannot read its data files; it needs a web server.
